A Monte Carlo estimate of $\pi$, and three ways of labeling a chart. Hover each chart for its fullscreen button.

```{ojs}
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

## A static key and a stat row

::: {.ojs-chart-block}
::: {.ojs-chart-controls}
```{ojs}
viewof piN = Inputs.range([10, 2000], {label: "samples n", step: 10, value: 500})
```
:::
```{ojs}
// The running estimate of pi from n seeded points in the unit square, and
// a band of two standard errors around it.
piRun = {
  const random = VM.sampling.seededRandom(7)
  const rows = []
  let inside = 0
  for (let n = 1; n <= piN; n++) {
    const x = random(), y = random()
    if (x * x + y * y <= 1) inside++
    const p = inside / n
    const se = 4 * Math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)
    rows.push({n, estimate: 4 * p, lo: 4 * p - 2 * se, hi: 4 * p + 2 * se})
  }
  return rows
}
```
```{ojs}
{
  const chart = Plot.plot(VM.plotting.plotOptions({
    width: 640, height: 320,
    x: {label: "n"}, y: {label: null, domain: [2.4, 3.9]},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(piRun, {x: "n", y1: "lo", y2: "hi", fill: chartColors.fn, fillOpacity: 0.2}),
      Plot.line(piRun, {x: "n", y: "estimate", stroke: chartColors.fn, strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.ruleY([Math.PI], {stroke: chartColors.alt, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "6,4"})
    ]
  }))
  const key = VM.ui.staticKey([
    {label: "estimate ± 2 s.e.", marks: [
      {mark: "area", fill: chartColors.fn, fillOpacity: 0.2},
      {mark: "line", stroke: chartColors.fn, strokeWidth: 2}
    ]},
    {label: "π", stroke: chartColors.alt, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "6,4"}
  ])
  const figure = document.createElement("div")
  figure.append(chart, key)
  return figure
}
```
```{ojs}
{
  const last = piRun[piRun.length - 1]
  return VM.ui.statRow([
    {label: "estimate", value: last.estimate.toFixed(4)},
    {label: "std. error", value: ((last.hi - last.lo) / 4).toFixed(4)},
    {label: "error", value: Math.abs(last.estimate - Math.PI).toFixed(4), title: "distance from π"}
  ])
}
```
:::

## A legend in the top-right corner

`corner: "top-right"` starts the legend below the Plotly modebar. Drag it by its grip; click a row to hide that trace.

::: {.ojs-chart-block}
```{ojs}
viewof cornerShown = VM.ui.legendOverlay([
  {label: "sin x", color: chartColors.fn},
  {label: "cos x", color: chartColors.alt},
  {label: "sin x cos x", color: chartColors.ok}
], {corner: "top-right"})
```
```{ojs}
{
  const xs = [], s = [], c = [], sc = []
  for (let i = 0; i <= 300; i++) {
    const x = -Math.PI + 2 * Math.PI * i / 300
    xs.push(x); s.push(Math.sin(x)); c.push(Math.cos(x)); sc.push(Math.sin(x) * Math.cos(x))
  }
  const data = [
    {name: "sin x", x: xs, y: s, line: {color: chartColors.fn, width: 2.5}},
    {name: "cos x", x: xs, y: c, line: {color: chartColors.alt, width: 2}},
    {name: "sin x cos x", x: xs, y: sc, line: {color: chartColors.ok, width: 2, dash: "dot"}}
  ]
  for (const trace of data) trace.visible = cornerShown.includes(trace.name) ? true : "legendonly"
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.style.height = "360px"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, data, VM.plotting.layout({showlegend: false, yaxis: {range: [-1.2, 1.2]}}), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```
:::

## A hand-built SVG

The library can't tell a hand-built `<svg>` chart from an icon, so it gets the SVG modebar only in a block marked `ojs-svg-block`.

::: {.ojs-chart-block .ojs-svg-block}
```{ojs}
{
  // The unit circle and the square it sits in, drawn by hand.
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
  const svg = document.createElementNS(ns, "svg")
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "-1.2 -1.2 2.4 2.4")
  svg.setAttribute("width", "320")
  svg.setAttribute("height", "320")
  svg.setAttribute("role", "img")
  svg.setAttribute("aria-label", "a unit circle inside a square")
  const shape = (tag, attrs) => {
    const el = document.createElementNS(ns, tag)
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) el.setAttribute(k, v)
    svg.append(el)
  }
  shape("rect", {x: -1, y: -1, width: 2, height: 2, fill: "none", stroke: chartColors.muted, "stroke-width": 0.02})
  shape("circle", {cx: 0, cy: 0, r: 1, fill: chartColors.fn, "fill-opacity": 0.2, stroke: chartColors.fn, "stroke-width": 0.03})
  return svg
}
```
:::

## A chart without a modebar

`data-vm-modebar="off"` on the chart, or anything around it, leaves it without one.

::: {.ojs-chart-block data-vm-modebar="off"}
```{ojs}
Plot.plot(VM.plotting.plotOptions({
  width: 640, height: 200,
  x: {label: "n"}, y: {label: "|error|", type: "log"},
  marks: [Plot.line(piRun.filter(r => r.estimate !== Math.PI), {x: "n", y: r => Math.abs(r.estimate - Math.PI), stroke: chartColors.alt})]
}))
```
:::
